subject: general
question: Two pipes can fill a cistern separately in 36 minutes and 45 minutes, respectively. A waste pipe can drain off 40 litres per minute. If all the three pipes are opened, the cistern fills in one hour. The capacity (in litres of the cistern) is:
solution:
**Given:**

Two pipes can fill a cistern separately in 36 minutes and 45 minutes, respectively.

A waste pipe can drain off 40 litres per minute.

If all three pipes are opened, the cistern fills in one hour.

**Formula used:**

Let the capacity of the cistern be x litres.

Rate of filling by the first pipe = x / 36 litres/minute

Rate of filling by the second pipe = x / 45 litres/minute

Rate of emptying by the waste pipe = 40 litres/minute

Net rate of filling when all three pipes are open = (x / 36) + (x / 45) - 40 litres/min
